rationales.objective_measurability: Criteria like 'identifies at least four distinct drawing element categories' and 'states at least two safety considerations' are highly objective and measurable[cite: 25].
rationales.objective_assessment_alignment: The integrated written performance task requires learners to execute all three objectives simultaneously, mirroring the brief[cite: 25].
rationales.evidence_validity: Working directly from a basic construction drawing set ensures authentic, high-fidelity assessment evidence[cite: 25].
rationales.cognitive_alignment: The progression from 'understand' (interpreting elements) to 'apply' (sequencing methods and identifying safety) is perfectly calibrated[cite: 25].
rationales.prerequisite_quality: Recognizing that basic drawing conventions must be a prerequisite ensures the 60 minutes are spent on interpretation and method planning, not basic symbol literacy[cite: 25].
rationales.course_sequence_coherence: The instructional sequence (Read -> Sequence -> Safety) is logically air-tight and reflects standard industry practice[cite: 25].
rationales.instruction_assessment_alignment: The use of worked examples and an integrated scenario effectively prepares the learner for the summative submission[cite: 25].
rationales.scope_balance: The scope covers interpretation, sequencing, and safety effectively. However, integrating all three complex outputs into a single cohesive assessment within the short time frame slightly limits the depth of the safety analysis[cite: 43].
rationales.workload_time_realism: There is meaningful time pressure. Extracting activities from a drawing, sequencing them, and deriving safety protocols within 60 minutes will require the provided drawing fixture to be extremely simplistic to be workable[cite: 43].
rationales.domain_appropriateness: The pedagogy perfectly matches construction engineering by linking drawing interpretation directly to method sequencing, and making safety explicitly traceable to site documents and procedures[cite: 43].

special_question.rationale: The design excellently maps the physical reality of construction operations—reading plans, sequencing work, and ensuring safety—into a highly coherent and domain-authentic learning path.
